collection.description: A child asks whether the ocean has a bottom.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks whether the ocean has a bottom.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a researcher, says the ocean has a bottom but depths vary greatly.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) wonders what lives in the darkest water.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) notices shallow pools and deeper channels.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) learns not to enter unfamiliar water.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) shares a tale of a bottomless sea as folklore.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks whether anyone has measured the deepest places.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) says many parts of the sea remain unexplored.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) imagines creatures that may never be seen.
